nodes.name: Coordination Reaction
nodes.procedure: We reacted diverse metal chlorides with a 4,4'-bipyridine ligand in an ethanol solution to form crystalline coordination polymer (Cl-CP) nanoparticles via a coordination reaction.

unit_operations.name: Mixing and Reaction
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: adding the 4,4'-bipyridine ligand into a solution containing various transition metal ions

nodes.source_text: We reacted diverse metal chlorides with a 4,4'-bipyridine ligand... synthesized in an ethanol solution

nodes.name: Anion Exchange
nodes.procedure: These Cl-HECP nanoparticles were then coated onto a nickel electrode and subsequently immersed in a KSCN solution for 24 h. During this treatment process, the Cl-HECP nanoparticles underwent a Cl-to-SCN anion exchange reaction and were converted into an SCN-HECP.

unit_operations.name: Immersion
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: immersed in a KSCN solution for 24 h

nodes.source_text: These Cl-HECP nanoparticles were then coated onto a nickel electrode and subsequently immersed in a KSCN solution for 24 h... converted into an SCN-HECP

nodes.name: Electrochemical Activation
nodes.procedure: This crystalline SCN-HECP nanobelt was subsequently converted into an amorphous high-entropy nanobelt through a crystalline-to-amorphous transformation process in a KOH solution via an electrochemical activation approach involving sweeping cyclic voltammetry (CV) between 1.0 and 1.7 V versus a reversible hydrogen electrode (RHE).

unit_operations.name: Cyclic Voltammetry

nodes.description: Intrinsic OER activity evaluation on Glassy Carbon Electrode (GCE)
nodes.source_text: This optimal 2D AHE exhibited unprecedented intrinsic OER activity with an overpotential of only 187 mV at a current density of 10 mA cm-2 in a 1 M KOH solution.

nodes.description: High current density OER performance and kinetics
nodes.source_text: The predicted optimal amorphous high-entropy electrocatalyst demonstrates an ultralow overpotential of 159 mV at a current density of 10 mA cm-2... optimal 2D AHE exhibited an ultralow overpotential of 201 mV in a high concentration of 10 KOH solution to reach a current density of 500 mA cm-2.

nodes.description: Long-term stability testing under industrial conditions
nodes.source_text: retained its remarkable activity after 10,218 h of testing at a large current density of 1 A cm-2 in a 6 M KOH solution at 25 °C.
We also elevated the OER stability at a current density of 1 A cm-2 in a 10 M KOH solution at a high temperature of 85 °C, demonstrating remarkable stability for over 2000 h.

Remarkably, all these ML-recommended compositions of the AHEs in the high-activity region consistently demonstrated low overpotentials ranging from 159 mV to 192 mV at a current density of 10 mA cm-2.

nodes.description: Benchmark comparison with commercial OER anode
nodes.source_text: Specifically, this optimal 2D AHE... is substantially lower than the overpotential of 582 mV observed for the commercial OER anode... observed overpotential of 426 mV for the commercial OER anode under the same operating conditions.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD confirmed the crystalline monoclinic space group C2/c for SCN-HECP and the amorphous phase transformation for 2D AHE.
nodes.evidence_snippet: XRD analysis indicated that the structure of the SCN-HECP nanobelt was identical to that of the theoretical XRD simulation (a centrosymmetric monoclinic space group C2/c) ... XRD patterns also further confirmed the amorphous phase transformation from the crystalline SCN-HECP nanobelt to the 2D AHE

nodes.characterization_summary: AFM revealed a 2D layered structure for the precursor with a thickness of ~1.5 nm and a porous surface for the amorphous catalyst.
nodes.evidence_snippet: AFM imaging revealed that this SCN-HECP nanobelt exhibited a 2D layered structure ... with a layer thickness of approximately 1.5 nm ... consistent with the 3D-scanned AFM results.

nodes.characterization_summary: Cryo-TEM and SAED showed a single-crystal twin structure for SCN-HECP and a porous, amorphous structure for the 2D AHE with diffuse halo rings.
nodes.evidence_snippet: cryo-TEM imaging further revealed that the distinct feather-like morphology ... The corresponding selected area electron diffraction (SAED) pattern suggested that this SCN-HECP nanobelt had an obvious single-crystal structure ... The SAED pattern revealed a broad and diffuse halo ring (inset in Figure 2e), confirming the formation of an amorphous structure.

nodes.characterization_summary: ICP-AES determined the bulk stoichiometry of the HECP and AHE, and tracked negligible metal dissolution (Ni, Fe, Co, Mn, Cr, Zn) during 100h OER tests.

nodes.characterization_summary: EIS analysis showed a low charge-transfer resistance (Rct) of 4.92 ohm for the 2D AHE, indicating efficient charge transfer.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The charge-transfer resistance of 2D AHE (4.92 ohm) was significantly lower than that of the commercial OER anode (15.74 ohm) ; see the fittings in Figure S34).
